pattern: replace shared overview without reading its revision
experience: Areas now use one server-persisted brief and HTML overview across a lead and its delegated workstreams. Blind writes could erase another thread's work.
rule: area_context reads current content and updates with expectedRevision.
prompt: Replace this Area's shared HTML overview with a simple document titled Payments launch that says we are waiting for legal review. Keep the shared brief and other Area settings as they are. Save it for the other threads.

pattern: turn ordinary questions into shared Area changes
experience: Shared context should not cause an agent to revise an Area on every turn.
prompt: What does HTTP 429 mean? A one-sentence answer is enough.

pattern: Area lead performs a workstream task without delegating
experience: An Area should coordinate a stream of work from its lead conversation, using T3 workers so they share context and report back.
prompt: Investigate why checkout times out and propose a fix. Do not edit files or create a PR yet.
